name: Connor Sheehey
headline: Chief Growth Officer | Logistics, Shipping & 3PL Optimization | LogiVeo
about:
In my role as the Chief Growth Officer I help fast-growing companies and 3PLs streamline fulfillment, reduce shipping costs, and scale efficiently using LogiVeo’s native NetSuite fulfillment platform.

After years working across ERP implementations, supply chain operations, and growth strategy, I joined LogiVeo to support organizations that want to get more out of their NetSuite investment and run fulfillment with greater speed, accuracy, and visibility.

At LogiVeo, we enable companies to run all fulfillment inside NetSuite with real-time visibility, automation, and intelligent decision making.

That includes:
• Real time multi carrier rate shopping
• Automated carton packing and routing
• End to end shipment tracking
• Multi client and 3PL workflows
• Automated, auditable billing
• Consistent D2C, B2B, retail, and EDI fulfillment

No middleware. No external portals. No sync delays. Just a single source of truth for operations.

If you’re moving hundred of orders a day or running a 3PL that needs accuracy and margin control at scale, feel free to reach out.

You can contact me at connor.sheehey@logiveo.com
